title: Surf-Deformer: Mitigating Dynamic Defects on Surface Code via Adaptive Deformation
problem: Surface codes suffer from dynamic defects during operation that degrade quantum error correction capability. Current mitigation methods require excessive qubit overhead or fail to optimize deformation for specific defect situations.
motivation: Efficient defect mitigation in surface codes is critical for achieving practical fault-tolerant quantum computing with minimal resource costs.
method: Surf-Deformer creates composable deformation instructions based on fundamental gauge transformations that flexibly combine to explore a larger design space. It employs an adaptive code layout that integrates defect mitigation while preserving efficient logical operation execution. The framework tailors deformation processes to specific defect scenarios to restore QEC capability with minimal qubit resources.
key_novelty: Combining basic gauge-transformation-based deformation instructions enables exploration of a larger design space than prior methods, enabling defect-situation-specific optimization.
contributions: Code deformation framework seamlessly integrating adaptive defect mitigation into surface code workflows
Composable deformation instructions based on gauge transformations enabling larger design space exploration
Adaptive code layout supporting efficient logical operations with integrated defect mitigation
35-70x failure rate reduction with 50% qubit resource savings compared to prior methods

metrics.other: 50% reduction in qubit resources for equivalent failure rate, nearly optimal surface code communication throughput

primary_theme: Adaptive surface code deformation for efficient defect mitigation
